raw_context:
Suzuken Co., Ltd.
is a major Japanese healthcare distributor and manufacturer. It creates medical equipment under its own brand and partners with
global and domestic firms for drug manufacturing, specialized contract logistics, and market entry support
武州製薬 株式会社
Product Brands and Manufacturing
Kenz Brand:
Suzuken manufactures diagnostic and monitoring equipment through its subsidiary
Kenzmedico Co., Ltd.
, producing electrocardiographs, Holter monitors, sphygmomanometers (blood pressure cuffs), and stethoscopes.
MarketResearch.com
Sanwa Kagaku Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. (SKK):
A consolidated Suzuken group pharmaceutical company focusing on research, development, and manufacturing of ethical drugs and diagnostic agents, notably for diabetes and kidney disease treatments.
EPSホールディングス株式会社
Key Manufacturer Partners and Alliances
Bushu Pharmaceuticals & EPS Holdings:
Formed a joint strategic partnership to help international drug developers introduce unapproved or foreign specialty drugs (drug-loss products) into the Japanese market.
武州製薬 株式会社
World Courier:
Collaborates on advanced, temperature-controlled cold chain logistics networks inside Japan to safely distribute sensitive cell and gene therapies, regenerative medicines, and orphan drugs.
World Pharma Today
Global Pharma Supply Relationships:
Acts as a specialized contract distributor and logistics provider handling pharmaceuticals, medical supplies, and diagnostic reagents sourced from hundreds of domestic and international drug makers.
